name: ⛏️ Dig DEEPER for Brainrots!
desc:
⛏️ Welcome to Dig DEEPER for Brainrots!
 
💎 Explore DEEPER into the mines
🔍 Discover Brainrots in the caves!
👊 Upgrade your POWER for HUGE HOLES!
⛏️ Earn money to buy better pickaxes!
🏆 Find the Strawberry Elephant!

❤️ If you enjoyed the game, don't forget to like and join the group!
